title: Ezekiel eats the scroll and receives his prophetic mission
description: God gives the prophet Ezekiel a scroll which he eats, and it tastes as sweet as honey in his mouth. Then the Lord sends him to the house of Israel to speak His words, warning that the people are rebellious and will not listen. God promises to make Ezekiel's forehead hard like a diamond, harder than flint, so that he need not fear them, and sends him to the exiles among his own people to proclaim the Lord's words whether they hear or refuse.
